hybrid_asymmetric_war.name: Hybrid Asymmetric Warfare
hybrid_asymmetric_war.description: Bleed stronger rivals through cheap autonomous swarms, irregular pressure and distributed logistics.

expeditionary_intervention.description: Project mobile joint forces across oceans and chokepoints faster than adversaries can fortify.

network_centric_warfare.description: Fuse sensors, long-range precision aviation and automated staff datalinks into a single kill chain.

fortress_deterrence.description: Make invasion prohibitively costly through layered coastal bastions, silent submarines and resilient reserves.
